_comment: Fill in each provider with a real endpoint. Your token from setup goes into api_key (__GATEWAY_TOKEN__ is replaced at install). One provider block per model. The `name,model` string (e.g. "anthropic,claude-opus-4-6") is what crew presets route on — see setup.sh. Transformer: use "Anthropic" for the Anthropic Messages API, "OpenAI" for OpenAI-compatible chat/completions (most other vendors).
